\title{Sasakian Manifolds}
\section{Introduction}
A pseudo-Hermitian manifold $(M,H,J,\theta)$ is called *Sasakian* if its pseudo-Hermitian torsion vanishes.

See also [[PseuHerm|Pseudo-Hermitian Geometry]].

\begin{definition}
A pseudo-Hermitian manifold is **Sasakian** if $\tau=0$.
\end{definition}

\begin{remark}
The Reeb vector field $\xi$ satisfies
\begin{equation}
\theta(\xi)=1,\qquad \iota_\xi d\theta=0.\label{eq:reeb}
\end{equation}
\end{remark}

By equation $\eqref{eq:reeb}$, the Reeb vector field is transverse to $H$.
